items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: See? And the red beans and rice is for the people what's living. And the flowers is for the people what? Is in there smelling flowers. Now, what's that you want to say, Mr. Russell?

ctx.x: See, the young ones make it, not the old ones can't make it. Yeah. Well of course the old ones make buses, while the young ones make it. Well that ought to be that they ought to have more of a better education now than, and more of a mother wit than what the older times, because they never had. You see in them days in time, Mr. Russel, in them days in time, we had the guests. We had the, we never had the teachers that they got today. Now today is the day you can get a teacher every minute in the day. You got…
